title: Modules through async
prompt: Export two functions. loadReport(read, name) awaits read(name) once. When it resolves, return { kind: "loaded", count } where count is the number of non-empty lines. When it rejects, return { kind: "missing", name }. catchesWrongCount(candidate) is a regression check for a line counter: return true for a counter that skips empty lines and false for one that counts every line.
hints: Use try/catch around the await so a rejection becomes the missing result.
Count lines that are not empty text.
Your check needs an input containing an empty line, so the two counters disagree.
checks: __same(await answer.loadReport(async () => { throw new Error("no"); }, "notes"), { kind: "missing", name: "notes" })

wrongAnswers.misconception: Tests only lines that are never empty.

feedback: Handle both promise outcomes, and choose a test input on which correct and broken code differ.
